comments.text:
FedEx driver here.

@2:00 That's outdated information. He's talking about the initial announcement of the merger, which was about a year and a half ago.

Fast-forward to today: Express, as its own division, is essentially done. Everything is now under Ground.
Why is Express done? More and more people are going paperless, so the demand for shipping physical documents is declining, which no longer justifies operating a separate division.
So what happens to Express drivers? They have only two options:

1. Go with the flow and work as a Ground driver.
2. If they don't want to be Ground drivers, that's it—they're gone. No job.
